description: An abstract base class for entity storage in Drupal, providing core methods for loading, saving, deleting, and caching entities, as well as handling hooks and queries.

classes.name: EntityStorageBase
classes.description: Provides core functionality for entity storage, including loading, saving, deleting, caching, and hook invocation within Drupal.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the base entity class name.

methods.name: getEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the entity type ID.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type definition object.

methods.name: buildCacheId
methods.description: Constructs a cache ID for a given entity ID.

methods.name: loadUnchanged
methods.description: Reloads an entity without affecting cache.

methods.name: resetCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for given entity IDs or the entire cache if no IDs are provided.

methods.name: getFromStaticCache
methods.description: Retrieves entities from static cache by IDs.

methods.name: setStaticCache
methods.description: Stores entities in static cache.

methods.name: invokeHook
methods.description: Invokes hooks for a specific entity operation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity instance with optional initial values.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Performs storage-specific creation of an entity.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a single entity by ID.

methods.name: loadMultiple
methods.description: Loads multiple entities by IDs, utilizing cache and preloading.

methods.name: preLoad
methods.description: Hook for preloading entities, can be overridden.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Attaches additional data to entities after loading.

methods.name: mapFromStorageRecords
methods.description: Converts storage records into entity objects.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Abstract method to check if an entity exists in storage.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes entities, invoking pre- and post-delete hooks.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Performs storage-specific deletion of entities.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an entity, handling pre- and post-save operations.

methods.name: doPreSave
methods.description: Performs pre-save processing, including validation and hook invocation.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Performs storage-specific save operation.

methods.name: doPostSave
methods.description: Performs post-save processing, cache invalidation, and hook invocation.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores an entity without invoking hooks.

methods.name: buildPropertyQuery
methods.description: Builds a property-based query for entities.

methods.name: loadByProperties
methods.description: Loads entities matching specific property values.

methods.name: hasData
methods.description: Checks if the storage has any data.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Gets an entity query object.

methods.name: getAggregateQuery
methods.description: Gets an aggregate entity query object.

methods.name: getQueryServiceName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the service name for entity queries.

methods.name: getEntitiesByClass
methods.description: Indexes entities by class and ID.
